detail.longDescription: New research paper search tools with MCP (Model Context Protocol) interfaces: Research Intelligence MCP: https:// github.com/supuni9622/research -intelligence-mcp Paper Search MCP: https:// github.com/openags/paper-searc h-mcp This one looks like the easiest one to set up: https:// builditwithai.xyz/find-researc h-papers-mcp/ There are probably other new search tools with MCP interfaces - it might be a good topic for someone to write blog article or research paper on comparing various tools and what to look for in them? # research # AI # tech # science # AItools # MCP # math
